title: Treatment of Nasal Staphylococcus Aureus Colonization in Patients With HHT
brief_summary: Compare the frequency of epistaxis and quality of life related to nasal bleeding in patients with HHT colonized with sataphylococo before and after being treated with mupirocin ointment.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients over 18 years with possible or confirmed HHT as diagnostic criteria Curaçao.
* Patients with nasal S. aureus colonization culture positive

Exclusion Criteria:

* Refusal to participate in the study or the informed consent process.
* Hypersensitivity or contraindication for topical mupirocin.
